blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The plunder case of Sen. Jinggoy Estrada in Sandiganbayan Fifth Division will see the testimony of “whistleblowers” and former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) chief Manuel Bonoan, his former co-accused in this non-bailable charge. Special prosecutors made this known Wednesday during the pre-trial proceeding of Estrada and his three remaining co-accused, who are former DPWH officials in Metro Manila, namely former assistant district engineer Denryl Caesar Cortuna and former district engineers Manny Bulusan and Arturo Gonzales Jr. READ: Estrada asks court to reconsider dropping of Bonoan in plunder, graft cases Estrada faced the non-bailable charge for allegedly receiving kickbacks worth P573 […]...
